assets.name: Field-guide paper

All four sides have exactly the same width; corners are square and perfectly aligned. Almost invisible fine uncoated paper fibers, no specks or printed marks. Exterior and large center opening are fully transparent alpha zero. Use clean smooth antialiased cut edges, with ivory RGB only at partially transparent edge pixels.
